patronOf.en-US: She pondered all these things in her heart
patronOf.pt-BR: Ela guardava tudo em seu coração

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Mary treasured all these words, reflecting on them in her heart.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Maria guardava todos estes fatos e meditava sobre eles em seu coração.

meta.face: Our Lady as in recurring-figures.md: a young woman of about eighteen with a delicate, softly OVAL face — a smooth high forehead, a fine straight nose with a narrow bridge, almond-shaped brown eyes under gently arched light-brown brows, softly rounded cheeks, a small rosy mouth, a small rounded chin; light-brown hair parted in the centre under a white inner veil and a blue mantle drawn over the head; her gaze lowered and inward, recollected, with the faintest smile.
meta.basis: The devotional image of the Immaculate Heart shows Our Lady pointing to her heart wreathed in roses with a flame above it; the sword of the Sorrows was left off because our_lady_sorrows already carries it. The enclosed garden is the hortus conclusus of Song of Songs 4:12, long read of her. Her face is the set's.
